subject: Follow-up: retention matrix request & dataportability asks
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearhealth.com>; security@clearhealth.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: retention matrix request & dataportability asks

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can move toward procurement and a brief security review: 

1) Retention/restore specifics we need scoped:
   - Primary log retention (live index) and any automated rollover windows.
   - Archive retention for logs (cold/long-term).
   - Snapshot/backup retention policy and typical restore RTO/RPO.
   - Policy for deletion: when a deletion request is issued, how are active copies, archives, and snapshots handled?

2) Evidence/attestations:
   - Current SOC 2 status and a redacted Type II report if possible.
   - Any documented playbook for restoring and then purging restored data (for legal hold scenarios).

3) Vendor questionnaire: I attached our short vendor security questionnaire (Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx). If you can complete that, Ben and I will follow up with any clarifying Qs.

Next steps proposed:
- If you can send a high-level retention matrix this week (log type -> retention -> backup retention -> notes) that'd be ideal.
- Complete the attached questionnaire by end of next week if feasible.
- We can schedule a 20-min follow-up to go over tricky parts (encryption, backup chain).

Thanks — excited to continue.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (survey)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: retention matrix request & dataportability asks

Laura — thanks for the note and the clear asks. Short answers / what we can provide quickly: 

- Live log retention: default 30 days (searchable).
- Archive retention: 365 days (cold storage, queryable via archive API).
- Backup/snapshot retention: full snapshots retained for 90 days, incremental deltas for 365 days (chain maintained for restore).
- Deletion SLA: active records removed within 7 days of request; archive purges initiated within 30 days, but backups are handled differently — restores from snapshot may require an additional purge workflow and typically take up to 90 days to complete across all backups.

We can provide a retention matrix and the SOC2 Type II report (redacted) — attaching our questionnaire draft as well so you can see our expectations. 

We will kick off the questionnaire internally and aim to return a completed version by Friday 26 Nov. If you need the SOC2 sooner, we can share a redacted copy by end of day Thursday.

Happy to do a quick sync if Ben wants to get granular on backup chain / encryption.

Cheers,
Daniel Park
Security & Compliance Lead
ClearHealth
daniel.park@clearhealth.com

Attachments: ClearHealth_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: retention matrix request & dataportability asks

Daniel — really appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifying questions to make the matrix actionable for our legal and engineering teams: 

- Snapshot chain: are the 90-day "full" snapshots independent, or are they incremental chains that require the 365-day delta to reconstruct older points-in-time? If incremental, can you provide average chain lengths?
- Encryption & keys: is data encrypted at rest with customer-segregated KMS keys (BYOK) or platform-managed keys? What is key rotation cadence?
- Deletion proof: do you produce verifiable deletion audit logs showing when the object was removed from active, archive, and snapshot layers? Can those be exported for compliance audits?
- Restore/purge workflow: when a legal deletion is initiated, what is the process to ensure restored copies are subsequently purged (if an earlier snapshot is used to restore accidentally)?

I've attached a simple retention matrix template (retention-matrix-template.xlsx) — if you can populate that, it will speed approvals. Target timeline from our side: we need the completed questionnaire and retention matrix by EOD Friday 26 Nov so legal can review the week of 29 Nov. If that's tight, flag which items will take longer.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: retention-matrix-template.xlsx

Subject: Re: Follow-up: retention matrix request & dataportability asks

Thanks Ben / Laura — we will populate the retention matrix and complete the questionnaire. Quick answers inline: 

- Snapshot chain: incremental chain today; average chain length ~12 deltas between full snapshots. We will note this explicitly in the matrix.
- Keys: platform-managed KMS today; customer BYOK is on the roadmap (Q2 2027). Rotation cadence: 90 days.
- Deletion proof: we maintain audit logs of deletion operations and can export a time-stamped report for compliance requests.
- Restore/purge workflow: after a restore, there is a manual purge ticket that triggers a secondary verification step; we'll include exact steps in the matrix.

Deliverables:
- Completed ClearHealth_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx by Friday 26 Nov.
- Retention matrix (populated) by Friday 26 Nov.
- SOC2 Type II (redacted) by Thursday 25 Nov.

If you think a short 20-min call would help clarify the incremental chain and purge workflow, I'm available Thu 25 Nov 10:00–12:00 PT.

Best,
Daniel Park
Security & Compliance Lead
ClearHealth
